subject: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal gating and capacity increment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: procurement@prismhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22 09:12 PDT
Subject: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal gating and capacity increment

Hi Emily / Prism team,

Quick note to kick off our renewal & capacity increase for the upcoming term. We’re aligned on scope (50% capacity uplift, 12-month extension) but your procurement team indicated you need us to re-onboard via the Prism procurement portal to accept the updated commercial terms and to get a fresh PO in place.

Ask: can you confirm the portal contact and the gating checklist you require? Specifically we need to know:
- whether Prism still requires a new vendor registration (tax/W-9 / EU VAT) or only a contract upload
- who will approve finance/cost center (name + email)
- expected PO issuance timeline once SOW is signed

We’ve attached an updated SOW (v3) and our procurement checklist for your team to compare with your portal requirements. Happy to jump on a 20-minute screen-share to walk through the portal fields if that helps.

Thanks — I’ll block 10–11am PT tomorrow for a quick follow-up unless you prefer another time.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW_PrisimHealth_Renewal_v3.pdf, Procurement_Onboard_Checklist.xlsx

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@prismhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@prismhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-22 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal gating and capacity increment

Hi Karthik — thanks for sending these over. Quick answers below:

- We do require a full vendor re-registration this cycle because of the capacity change and updated tax info. The portal will ask for W-9 (US) and our new counterparty questionnaire.
- Finance approver: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@prismhealth.com) — she’ll need the final SOW + list of cost centers.
- Typical PO issuance for renewals is 7–10 business days after SOW countersigned and vendor is verified in the portal. If we receive the signed SOW by Friday we can target PO by next Friday.

We’ve created a portal ticket for you: PR-7721. I’ll paste the link in a follow-up (internal firewall rules). If you want to do a 20-minute walkthrough, Daniel and I can join tomorrow at 10am PT.

Emily
Procurement Manager, PrismHealth
emily.chen@prismhealth.com

Date: 2028-03-22 11:28 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal gating and capacity increment

Thanks Emily — looping in our finance lead and legal playbook. A few quick notes from our side that typically speed Prism’s portal path:

- Vendor re-registration: we can pre-populate the portal form fields if you send a CSV template. That usually removes two back-and-forths.
- Tax docs: W-9 is attached. (Also happy to provide EU VAT on request — not applicable for US entity.)
- SOW: Karthik’s attached v3 includes the capacity increase and an optional auto-scaling addendum. If you prefer fewer line items on the portal, we can provide a condensed SOW with a single committed capacity figure and an appendix for burst terms.

Action items for Prism team:
1) Share CSV template for vendor registration or confirm that portal upload accepts PDF form fields.
2) Confirm PO timeline and whether a single PO can cover both base committed capacity and the add-on.

We’ll be on the call at 10am PT if that still works.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: W9_Redwood.pdf

From: Daniel Reyes <daniel.reyes@prismhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@prismhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-22 14:01 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding: procurement portal gating and capacity increment

Hi Marissa / Karthik — quick follow-up from our 10am call: appreciate you walking us through the SOW. I pulled the ticket PR-7721 and confirmed the portal accepts CSV for vendor info and a single PDF for SOW. Two small asks from legal:

1) Can you remove the indemnity clause paragraph 5.2 and replace with the mutual indemnity language we discussed (I pasted the text below)?
2) Please add an insurance certificate (proof of cyberliability) to the upload bundle — our portal flags missing certs and stalls verification.

If you push the revised SOW + insurance cert by EOD Thursday, I’ll prioritize the vendor verification step so finance can issue PO the following week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Procurement Specialist, PrismHealth

- Attached: SOW_PrisimHealth_Renewal_v3_signed_stub (we routed the redline changes Daniel requested; legal signed early this morning). Full signed SOW will arrive via DocuSign by EOD; I included the DocuSign link in related_links.

- We pre-filled the vendor CSV per your template and uploaded to ticket PR-7721. Ticket status is now "vendor info submitted".

Laura — when you have a minute can you confirm the cost center code below so we can mark the PO request?
- Cost center: INF-OPS-2043

If we get your confirmation today and DocuSign clears, Daniel indicated finance can aim to issue a single PO covering the base plus the committed uplift within 7 business days. Marissa / Vivek — I’ll flag this as high priority in the renewal plan.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Please let me know if you want me to open a procurement exception case for faster processing.

Best,
